note: Fixed, reproducible tool catalog for the acceptance test. Collections are pinned to a commit: "HEAD" is resolved to a SHA by build-catalog.mjs and written back here, so later runs use the same content. `roots` are folders whose direct children are skills (one * segment allowed); `installed` lists the skills copied into the agents' skill folders, every other skill of the collection goes to the library. placement "library" puts the whole collection in the library.
